query: I have a 64‑year‑old woman hospitalized with heart failure. Among female inpatients aged 59–69 with HF, report in‑hospital mortality, AKI and ARDS rates, median survival among in‑hospital deaths, and the composite risk score distribution (min, P25, median, P75, P90, max).
final_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(p.subject_id), 0) AS mortality_rate, CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL AND p.diagnoses_icd.icd_code = '250.0' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(p.subject_id), 0) AS aki_rate, CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL AND p.diagnoses_icd.icd_code = '370.0' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(p.subject_id), 0) AS ards_rate, MEDIAN(CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN (p.dischtime - p.admittime) END) AS median_survival, percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY (p.dischtime - p.admittime)) AS p25_survival, percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY (p.dischtime - p.admittime)) AS p75_survival, percentile_cont(0.90) within GROUP (ORDER BY (p.dischtime - p.admittime)) AS p90_survival, percentile_cont(0.05) within GROUP (ORDER BY (p.dischtime - p.admittime)) AS min_survival FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 59 AND 69 AND p.diagnoses_icd.icd_code = '415.999' AND a.hadm_id IN (SELECT hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE subject_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM patients WHERE gender = 'F' AND anchor_age BETWEEN 59 AND 69 AND diagnoses_icd.icd_code = '415.999'));
